purpose: Select one view within a shared context using Base UI tabs, with either per-tab panels or one persistent shared content slot.
anatomy: overflow wrapper and named tab list
behaviorProvider: @base-ui/react Tabs and DirectionProvider supply tab/list/panel interaction; Aegis owns uncontrolled selection initialization and styling.

component: shared panel slot identity and decorative icon treatment
host: unique stable values and usable tab labels
valid selection when items change and panel content semantics

requirements.statement: Without value, initialize internal selection from defaultValue or the first enabled item. Later changes to defaultValue do not reset internal selection.
With value supplied, forward that selection to Base UI and emit string onValueChange requests without updating internal selection. Non-string primitive changes are ignored.

Use unique stable item values and ensure a controlled or initial value identifies an appropriate enabled item. When items are removed or disabled, reconcile selection deliberately; this wrapper has no reconciliation effect.

Set Base UI List activateOnFocus=true for automatic activation and false for manual activation. Preserve the primitive keyboard and disabled-tab behavior instead of adding independent click-only selection.
Forward orientation and root HTML properties to Base UI Root. An explicit ltr/rtl dir selects the DirectionProvider direction; otherwise use the inherited direction.
Supply a meaningful label for the tablist and accessible item labels. The default Views label is generic; icons are aria-hidden and cannot replace the textual name.

Without sharedContent, render a Base UI Panel for each item value. When sharedContent is defined, render one unkeyed Panel associated with the current active value and place the shared content there instead of item.content.

Use sharedContent for a persistent workspace and keep its component type/key stable if local drafts must survive tab changes. Per-tab inactive-panel mounting follows Base UI defaults; the wrapper does not expose keepMounted or persist each view draft.
Render a count when it is not undefined, display 99+ above 99, and retain the full numeric count in an aria-label. Counts are descriptive metadata rather than selection state.
Use navigation group tokens for the line/pill tab treatments and overflow layout. Presentation changes must preserve Base UI focus behavior, semantic relationships and the selected host state.

limitations: This wrapper does not route, fetch data, reconcile removed active values or preserve every inactive panel draft.
Shared-content state preservation depends on stable caller content identity; it is not persistence across unmounts or routes.
Primitive keyboard and panel lifecycle behavior is delegated to the installed Base UI version, not independently reimplemented or certified by this document.
